condition: post-hoc physical source-only alternative launch distances, 3 sources × 3 dates × 3 valid NOAA ocean cells per band
source_data: NOAA old OSCAR 2005 and early 2006 15m ~5day 1/3degree gridded u/v, GSHHG fine ocean mask unchanged

source_availability_summary.status: Original 3 validated NOAA offshore source cells found in all nine source×date checks per band

interpretation: Completion rate responds to initial distance from an indexed WPI coastal proxy; not evidence of naturally released floating seeds reaching destination islands.
critical_limits: The upper bound of 80-160 km band was not explored evenly (median actual 84.63 km), so no quantitative inference for 160km starting points.
This comparison was conducted after observing 19/27 near-coastal mask contacts; no pre-registration or independent species replication.
Only representative port-to-port 50km proximity was assessed, not all destination coastlines.
Start points are artificial gridded ocean locations, not historically observed viable propagules.
Real seed flotation time, survival, windage, Stokes drift and nearshore currents not included.
Do not equate current model particles with botanical colonizations, shipping routes or butterfly landings.
